prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: seamless tileable 2D game ground texture for a top-down survivor arena
Style/medium: polished hand-painted fantasy game texture, soft painterly forms, readable at gameplay scale, restrained detail
Composition/framing: exact orthographic top-down view, square texture, fully seamless on all four edges, evenly distributed surface variation, no focal point
Lighting/mood: diffuse neutral ambient light baked very lightly; no directional shadows
Constraints: ground surface only; low contrast so characters, projectiles and hazards remain readable; no props, no objects, no walls, no borders, no horizon, no perspective, no text, no runes, no emblems, no logos, no watermark; avoid obvious repeated motifs
Primary request: hall-of-salvation floor made of warm ivory marble paving transformed by a sunset palette: peach, coral rose, amber gold and soft lavender reflections distributed through the stone
Color palette: clearly warm sunset theme, peach, rose, amber, lavender and warm ivory; visually distinct from a cool white heavenly floor, no glowing symbols
